'''Hevanus Dreed''' was a famous individual in [[44 ABY]]. Dreed and [[Koy'tiffin]], a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] and stage [[Actor/Legends|actress]], were some of the available choices to take a [[holostill]] with on a market in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
